name: tiagox-claude-code-mods
description: My personal Claude Code plugin marketplace.

plugins.name: prompt-timestamp
plugins.description: Adds a date line to every prompt, a timestamp beside every terminal message, and a timestamp to every Claude response.

plugins.name: session-config-line
plugins.description: Shows a context usage bar, the model, the effort level, and the usage limits above the prompt hint line.

plugins.name: secret-redactor
plugins.description: Hides the secrets in your MCP server configuration and .env files from the agent by redacting them from tool results.

plugins.name: agent-config-skills
plugins.description: A set of high level Claude Code skills to write structured and consistent agent instructions.
